name: coordination-hooks
description: An unconditional project-orientation reminder, opt-in unread-message and role-binding reminders, and a Git-Controller mistake-prevention gate for coordinated multi-session work.

interface.shortDescription: Reviewable hooks for coordinated Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Adds an unconditional project-orientation reminder plus opt-in unread-message and role-binding reminders, and a Git-Controller mistake-prevention gate. No Stop-bound delivery watcher ships currently: stock Codex does not execute async command hooks, so a bound one never fires (codex-0147-async-hook-regression). Autonomous turns belong to managed-session driver channels (spawn_session's drive_on_delivery), unaffected by this. Deployment-specific guidance stays in the project's native AGENTS.md instructions, and hook revocation remains an explicit operator action in Codex's supported /hooks surface.
defaultPrompt: Explain the installed coordination hook contract.
